notes.title: The weapon update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
WOW! Has it been over 1.5 years!?!? Well guess what! The promised tower store update is here! 

There are now 7 weapons and power-ups to buy and use at your leisure! Long range, short range, boosts, all kinds of things! 

Remember how infuriating it was to spend 50 feathers on that invincibility power-up only to have it run out before you get to where you need it? Well no more! Every power-up you buy in the shop will be in your inventory (pause screen). When the game is paused, use the Left/Right movement buttons to select the sub-weapon/power you want to bind to the “B” button. Use them where, when, and how you want to!

We’ve also tweaked enemy powers and level layouts a bit to make things all-round more enjoyable and less confusing or irritating.

Additionally, a few issues have been fixed that should make wing’s movement a bit better… speaking of faster movement- We’ve been thinking about ways to help out all you speed runners out there. Expect a speed-runner centric update sometime in the next couple months :) 

Now that we’re flying again, expect some more tweaks to the end-game soon too, as well as more cool things we’ll divulge in the future!

Again, sorry for the wait all! We hope you all enjoy these new features :D

notes.title: New shop items are in final testing!
notes.content:
The complete list is as follows:

[list]
[*][b]Long Swing[/b] A sword swing about 2x longer then normal
[*][b]360 Swing[/b] A fast, close combat, circular sword swipe that hits enemies all around the player.
[*][b]Triple Shot[/b] 3 arrow shots, half as powerful as a normal sword swipe, fire out in a semi-spread fashion. These arrows are sort distance shots  (about 4 tiles in distance)
[*][b]Quad Shot[/b] 4 arrows, half as powerful as a normal sword swipe, fire out around the player in the 4 cardinal directions. These arrows are sort distance shots  (about 4 tiles in distance)
[*][b]Power Increase[/b] This increases wings attack power by 1.5x the normal power. It lasts for 15 seconds.
[*][b]Air Shield[/b] This absorbs one hit from any enemy. This does not protect against level hazards such as spikes and lava.
[*][b]Invincibility Feathers[/b] This item is already in the game, however now it is saved in your inventory and activated manually.
[/list]

In addition to these new items, the 4 other items (Health Refill, Health Upgrade, Extra Life, and Revive Potion) are still available.

Each shop will contain a different set of items. Be sure to always have lots of coins and feathers saved up! if you don't, you may not find a particular item again until much later in the game!

Also, a new alternate-attack button has been added to the game. This alternate attack button will use whatever item/weapon you have assigned to the "B" slot. [b]Make sure to adjust your control setup once you update[/b]

Expect the new game version to be released sometime this week!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CXN4nKGUwAAITwJ.png[/img]

-Pix

notes.title: Small Balancing Update v1.0a
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We just released a small update that fixes some balancing and level confusion issues! Specifically:
-Wing's basic attack now has a little more reach
-Wing's sword charge attack is now faster to charge
-The size of enemy hit boxes that hurt the player have been tweaked
-Confusing looping-rooms in 2 areas have been fixed
